note: RTP configurations read off a studio's OWN game page, overriding or supplying what the catalogue import holds. The import is a third-party feed; a studio publishing its own numbers beats it. Each entry records the page the figures came from and the date read. Keep this file out of the importer's way: gameCatalogue.json is regenerated from the CSV and would lose anything written into it.

retro-sweets.reason: The catalogue import carried no RTP at all for this title. Push Gaming publishes two on their own game page, under a heading that reads 'RTP's may vary per casino. The RTP of the game can be found in the user panel and on the game loading screen.'

big-bamboo.reason: The catalogue import carried a single 95.11%, which matches NEITHER figure Push Gaming publishes. It may be a third licensed build or a bad row; either way the studio's own page is the better source, and it gives two. The import value is not carried through — a number we cannot trace to the studio is not one to publish next to ones we can.
